description: US doctors, dentists, therapists, clinics and hospitals from the official NPI Registry: name, specialty (taxonomy), license, practice address, phone, fax, enumeration date and, for organizations, the authorized official. Search by specialty, state, city, ZIP, name or NPI; can keep only new practices (recently issued NPIs) or providers with a phone. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/npi-providers on your Apify account (about $0.003 per provider; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

enumerated_within_days.description: Only NPIs issued in the last N days (new practices).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 100, max 5000). Cost scales with this.

organization_name.description: Organization name; * for a prefix, e.g. "smile*".

with_phone_only.description: Only providers with a practice phone.

name: search_healthcare_providers

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search US healthcare providers (NPI Registry)
